blurb: If you’re looking for the best Charleston SC party boat, you just found it. The Friki Tiki is a 32-passenger BYOB tiki boat cruising Charleston Harbor daily and whether you’re here for a wild bachelorette weekend, a laid-back birthday, a corporate team outing, or just a Tuesday that needs improving, we’ve got a cruise for you.We’re not a dinner cruise. We’re not a stuffy harbor tour.

quotes.text: Tiki Tours was the highlight of our trip. 9 of us really enjoyed our 2 1/2 hour boat tour. They were on time to pick us up with fantastic communication prior to our departure. They had coolers with ice and a loud speaker waiting on board for when we arrived. About halfway through the trip, they inflated rafts and let us swim. They had props and helped video/photo our fun. Highly recommend this boat tour!

We booked a semi private cruise for my bachelor party and everyone had a great time. They said it was the best part of the trip. The captain/crew was amazing and provided us with great service. Sam was able to accomadate a last minute change with no hesitation. Thanks so much!

The owners went out of the way to accommodate our group last minute and provided an amazing experience. The boat is super large with plenty of space to walk around, play games, and enjoy the views of Charleston. 10/10 recommend.

The best cruise in Charleston. We enjoyed the cruise as a team outing and highly recommend! Natalia & Sam were the best on board and we can't wait to come back soon. Don't miss this for your next trip to Charleston!
Sam and Nathalia were beyond amazing! I highly recommend tiki tours to anyone that is interested in seeing the true beauty of Charleston, from the water! #bestpartyboat
